items.title: What Is Medtronic (MDT) Facing After Two Class II Cardiac Device Recalls?
items.summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) initiated two Class II device recalls in November 2026 covering cardiac products used in implantable therapies. The OmniaSecure Model 3930M cardiac lead recall cites product performance concerns, including difficulties with lead fixation during implantation. The CareLink SmartSync Programmer recall focuses on software issues that can produce inaccurate estimates of implanted device battery longevity.
